sn22.120:1.1: sāvatthinidānaṁ saṁyojaniye → sāvatthiyaṁ saññojaniye (bj); sāvatthī saññojaniye (sya-all);  (pts)
sn22.120:1.2: desessāmi saṁyojanañca → desissāmi saññojanañca (bj, sya-all); desissāmi saññojānaṁ ca (pts) | desessāmi → desessāmī (cck)
sn22.120:1.4: saṁyojaniyā → saññojaniyā (bj, sya-all) | saṁyojanaṁ → saññojanaṁ (bj, sya-all); ca saññojanaṁ (pts) | saṁyojaniyā dhammā → saññojaniyādhammā (pts)
sn22.120:1.12: saṁyojaniyā → saññoniyā (bj); saññojaniyā (sya-all, pts) | saṁyojananti aṭṭhamaṁ → saññojananti (bj, sya-all); saññojananti sāvatthi (pts)
